design_overview: A modern, production-ready inventory management mobile application designed for store owners, managers, and clerks. The interface prioritizes quick barcode scanning, real-time inventory visibility, and actionable alerts. The design follows native iOS/Android patterns with clear visual hierarchy, touch-friendly components, and seamless navigation between core workflows: scanning products, managing inventory, viewing alerts, and analyzing sales data.

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices. Layouts use flexible containers and relative sizing. Minimum touch target size 44x44px. Supports portrait and landscape orientations with adaptive layouts. Bottom navigation remains fixed. Scrollable content areas use momentum scrolling. Cards and lists stack vertically on mobile, may use grid on tablets.
accessibility: All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for text). Icons paired with text labels. Form inputs have clear labels and placeholders. Error states use both color and text. Screen reader support with semantic HTML/native components. Focus indicators visible for keyboard navigation. Alternative text for all images. Haptic feedback for key actions.
animations: Smooth transitions between screens (300ms ease-in-out). Button press states with scale (0.95) and opacity (0.8). Modal slides from bottom with spring animation. Toast notifications slide from top. Loading spinners rotate continuously. Pull-to-refresh with elastic bounce. Swipe gestures for dismissible cards. Skeleton screens for loading states. Micro-interactions on success (checkmark animation, confetti for milestones).
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style. Icons: home (house), search (magnifying glass), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (favorite), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (bin), share (arrow). Icons sized 24x24px for navigation, 20x20px for inline use. Primary color for active states, gray for inactive.
